device.page.title: My devices
device.everywhere.title: Sign out everywhere?
device.everywhere.body: Every device signed in to your account is signed out, this one included. Changes a device has not sent yet stay on it until you sign in there again.
device.notice.read-failed: Your devices could not be read. Check your connection and try again.
device.notice.sign-out-failed: The sign-out did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
